hedging_delta.evidence: Prior call emphasized 'uncertainty,' 'nonlinear demand,' conservative license assumptions; current call speaks more confidently of 2026 acceleration with fewer caveats.

guidance_direction.evidence: Prior Q4 guide was $6.7B rev/$2.11 EPS (both down sequentially); current Q1 guide is $6.85B rev/$2.18 EPS, above prior quarter's guided levels.

quant_claim_escalation.evidence: DRAM leading-edge growth 'up around 50% in fiscal 2025' (prior) vs 'growing... by more than 50% over the past 4 fiscal quarters' (current) - essentially held, not escalated.

new_topic_rate.evidence: New product launches (Xtera, Kinex, PROVision 10) and reporting-structure changes (200mm move, display reclassification) not discussed in prior call.

tone_delta.evidence: Prior call stressed 'record performance'; current call admits growth 'was tempered' and 'trimmed our growth rate,' more restrained framing.

demand_language_delta.evidence: Prior call framed near-term demand issues as temporary digestion; current call cites China WFE spending 'lower' in 2026 and growth deferred to 'second half of calendar 2026,' a further delay.
